description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and termination, using the runc command-line tool within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle commands (create, exec, delete, state, list) via runc CLI.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container's process ID and status, serializable to/from JSON.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Holds container configuration including environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Contains environment variables for container process configuration.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Implements container interface for runc-based containers, managing start, stop, and status.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a command and parameters.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces of the container (not implemented).

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Internal method to delete container if running.
